items.title: Tether's excess reserves nearly double to $8B as Q3 profit hits $1.5B
items.summary: The stablecoin issuer's US Treasury holdings are comparable to those of major foreign holders, while its Bitcoin reserves were valued at $8.37 billion.

items.title: Coinbase leads crypto stock selloff following $6.3B Binance hack
items.summary: Circle, Strategy and other crypto-linked stocks fell sharply Friday, a day after Binance disclosed a $6.3 billion security breach.

items.title: Binance Hack: Why Bitcoin Didn't Crash Like It Did in 2018
items.summary: Binance lost about $6.4 billion, the largest crypto hack on record, yet Bitcoin fell about 3%, against nearly 11% in 2018 when the exchange was last attacked.

items.title: Binance says it has $6.34 billion ready to cover hack losses
items.summary: Binance has allocated $6.34 billion to cover hack losses, while industry partners have frozen another $3 billion in affected assets.

items.title: Binance uncovers wider breach in $6.3 billion exploit, targets Sunday withdrawal restart
items.summary: CEO Richard Teng said hackers erased evidence and bypassed security checks. Binance plans to publish its proof of reserves Monday.
